updates.new_facts: Grace observed Derek removing a bullet from his arm without a shirt on, fled in embarrassment when caught spying, and later shared a quiet, intimate moment with him on the rooftop.
updates.quote: One shirtless man had completely destroyed her mental stability.

timeline_events.title: The First Crack
timeline_events.description: Following a war, Grace discovers Derek removing a bullet from his own arm without his control chip, leading to a vulnerable moment of connection between them on the rooftop.
timeline_events.quote: The compound was quiet for the first time in hours. Not safe quiet—just the exhausted kind. The kind that followed a war.
